# PERSONALIZE — Your Fill-In Worksheet

> Every `__FILL_FROM_USER__` site, grouped by file — the checklist to make this template yours.
> **Easiest path:** open this repo in Claude Code and say *"set up my second brain"* — the `/setup`
> skill interviews you and fills these in order. Or walk this list yourself.
> Find them live anytime: `grep -rn "__FILL_FROM_USER__" .`

**Recommended order** — you have a working brain after the first two:
1. `CLAUDE.md` → `owner_one_liner`, and `Orientation_Docs/INTELLECTUAL_LANDSCAPE_LITE.md` → `brain_purpose` + `who_i_am` (~10 min). *Routing works after these.*
2. `gaps_filled` (what this brain should shore up) + `STATE_OF_SECOND_BRAIN.md` + `FOLDER_ORIENTATION.md`.
3. `Orientation_Docs/PRIVACY_DEPTH.md` → `depth_calibration` (define your 1–5 privacy levels).
4. Voice, full landscape, keywords, taxonomy — as you go.
5. Skill / hook markers — only when you wire up that skill (see `SETUP.md`).
